gloss: dressing as a man; male attire (on a woman); cross-dressing (female-to-male)

definitions.gloss: the act of a woman dressing in men's clothing, or the male appearance thus produced — includes theatrical cross-dressing, cosplay, and everyday fashion
definitions.explanation: Refers specifically to a woman adopting a male appearance through clothing, hairstyle, and sometimes binding or makeup. The word is neutral and covers a wide range of contexts: the all-female {宝塚|たからづか} revue where actors play male roles, anime and manga characters, historical disguise, cosplay, and gender-expression fashion.

examples.japanese: {男装|だんそう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: She dressed as a man and walked around town.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{男装|だんそう}⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦かっこいい→かっこいい：09378_kakkoii⟧。
examples.english: She looks really cool dressed as a man.

examples.japanese: {宝塚|たからづか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{男装|だんそう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{男役|おとこやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演|えん}じる→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧。
examples.english: In the Takarazuka Revue, female performers dress as men to play the male roles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦国|せんごく}{時代|じだい}→戦国時代：19200_sengokujidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{男装|だんそう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{戦場|せんじょう}→戦場：12746_senjou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{登場|とうじょう}→登場：13625_toujou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Stories about the Warring States period often feature women who disguise themselves as men and head off to the battlefield.

notes:
Composed of {男|だん} ("man") + {装|そう} ("attire, dressing"). Always refers to a female wearing men's clothing; for the reverse, use ⟦{女装|じょそう}→女装：12643_josou⟧.

TRANSITIVITY:
- {男装|だんそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is intransitive: the subject is the person doing the dressing, not something being dressed.
- Usually expressed as ⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{男装|だんそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, never 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{男装|だんそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

USAGE:
- Common fixed phrases: {男装|だんそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ ("to dress as a man"), {男装|だんそう}⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧ ("appearance dressed as a man"), {男装|だんそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{麗人|れいじん} ("beautiful cross-dressed woman" — a somewhat literary/romantic set phrase).
- Frequent in contexts of theater ({宝塚|たからづか}, ⟦{歌舞伎|かぶき}→歌舞伎：04455_kabuki⟧), historical fiction, anime/manga, cosplay, and fashion.
- Neutral in register; neither positive nor negative on its own. The related {異性装|いせいそう} is a more clinical/gender-studies term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {男装|だんそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dress as a man
- {男装|だんそう}⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧: appearance dressed as a man
- {男装|だんそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{麗人|れいじん}: a beautiful woman dressed as a man (set phrase)
- {男装|だんそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}する→外出する：26841_gaishutsusuru⟧: to go out dressed as a man

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{女装|じょそう}→女装：12643_josou⟧: dressing as a woman — the symmetric counterpart.
- ⟦{変装|へんそう}→変装：12098_hensou⟧: disguise — any change of appearance to hide identity; broader than gender alone.
- {異性装|いせいそう}: cross-dressing — a gender-neutral, more academic term.
- {男役|おとこやく}: a male role (played by a woman) — the theatrical role, not the clothing.
